rules.title: Suspicious install lifecycle script
rules.message: Install scripts that download or eval code are a supply-chain risk.
rules.fix: Audit the package; pin versions; avoid untrusted deps with install hooks.

rules.title: Extra/untrusted package index
rules.message: Non-default indexes can enable dependency confusion / tampering.
rules.fix: Prefer official indexes; authenticate private indexes; pin hashes.

rules.title: curl|wget piped to shell
rules.message: Piping remote scripts to a shell is a classic supply-chain foothold.
rules.fix: Download, verify checksum/signature, then run from a reviewed local file.
